boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase activities documented by Pitzer and nearby Claremont cultural organizations.

cards.title: Add a piece to the Free Wall
cards.subtitle: Mead Hall, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Bring your own supplies, check the wall’s current layer, and add public art here rather than beginning a separate outdoor-art proposal.
cards.short_summary: A student-designated space for uncensored, changing public art.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer identifies the Free Wall on Mead Hall as the location where students may create public art without the Aesthetics Committee process.
cards.access_notes: Student activity; use the Mead Hall Free Wall and follow campus expectations. The source explicitly says students are free to create art there without committee review.

cards.title: Borrow a Green Bike
cards.subtitle: Green Bike Program, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Ask the student-run shop about a loaner bike, then make a low-key ride around the Claremont Colleges with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free loaner-bike option for Pitzer students.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer says its student-run Green Bike Program lets Pitzer students borrow free loaner bikes from the shop.
cards.access_notes: For Pitzer students; confirm loaner availability with the Green Bike Program before going.

cards.title: Learn a bike fix together
cards.subtitle: Green Bike Program, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Use the shared tools and ask about repair lessons; pick one simple adjustment to practice before heading out on a campus ride.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on bike maintenance with community tools and instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer states that the Green Bike Program gives community members free access to tools and repair lessons.
cards.access_notes: Available to community members according to Pitzer; contact greenbike@students.pitzer.edu for current shop access.

cards.title: Join a Student Garden workshop
cards.subtitle: Pitzer Student Garden, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Check the Garden Club’s current workshop plans, then come ready to learn, make something, or help with a community garden activity.
cards.short_summary: Student Garden programming centered on a shared food-forest space.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer describes the Student Garden as hosting free educational workshops and says no garden experience is necessary to join the Garden Club.
cards.access_notes: Workshop timing varies; contact pzgarden@pitzer.edu or the Garden Club before attending.

cards.title: Volunteer at Pomona Farm
cards.subtitle: Pomona Farm, Pomona College
cards.notes: Coordinate with the Farm before arriving, then spend time tending beds or learning how the campus farm operates with other student volunteers.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost student volunteer experience at Pomona’s working farm.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer states that students can experience Pomona Farm volunteering for free, although non-student volunteers typically need a garden membership.
cards.access_notes: For students; coordinate with Pomona Farm or its volunteer contact in advance.

cards.title: Stop by the chicken coop
cards.subtitle: North side of Mead Hall, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Walk over from Mead Hall, observe the flock quietly, and keep the visit brief so the birds and nearby residents are not disturbed.
cards.short_summary: A casual outdoor stop with Pitzer’s small flock of chickens.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer’s official walking-tour guide says visitors may stop by the chicken coop on the north side of Mead Hall and greet the flock.
cards.access_notes: Observe from the appropriate public path; do not enter the coop or handle animals. The official tour explicitly invites a stop.

cards.title: See the Claremont Lewis Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 200 W. First Street, Claremont
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, browse the current exhibition at your own pace, and pair the visit with a walk through the adjacent Claremont Village.
cards.short_summary: A Claremont Depot museum with free student admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Lewis Museum of Art lists general admission as free for students.
cards.access_notes: Students are admitted free; check the museum’s current open days and bring student identification if requested.

cards.title: Listen at Fourth Saturdays Poetry
cards.subtitle: Claremont Helen Renwick Library, 208 N. Harvard Ave.
cards.notes: Check the next reader lineup, arrive for the scheduled afternoon start, and stay afterward to discuss a poem or meet other attendees.
cards.short_summary: A recurring public poetry-reading series at the Claremont library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friends of the Claremont Library describes Fourth Saturdays Poetry Readings as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; confirm the upcoming date because the series schedule can change.

cards.entity_name: Claremont: On the Same Page Community Read
cards.title: Join an On the Same Page event
cards.subtitle: Claremont Helen Renwick Library and local venues
cards.notes: Read as much of the selected book as you like, then choose a related talk or discussion from the community-read event schedule.
cards.short_summary: Free public programs built around Claremont’s annual community read.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friends of the Claremont Library states that all events for its 2025–2026 Claremont Community Read are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the book may be obtained separately, but attendance at the listed events requires no purchase.

cards.title: Walk Pitzer’s mural-filled campus
cards.subtitle: Begin at Admission Plaza, Pitzer College
cards.notes: Start at Admission Plaza and follow the College’s walking-tour route through Holden Garden, Mead Hall, the Mounds, and the Academic Quad.
cards.short_summary: A self-directed route through named Pitzer campus landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitzer publishes a walking-tour guide that begins at Admission Plaza and directs visitors through Holden Garden, Mead Hall, the Mounds, and the Academic Quad.
cards.access_notes: The College provides this self-guided campus walking tour; follow campus visitor guidance and avoid residence-only areas.
